_about: A made world: what Ling writes when the player wants a world of their own. One outline in this shape, laid over a shipped world (`base`): the systems — ladder, stamina, wealth, the bag, tasks, quests, contests — are the base's; the story, the words, the places and the cast are this world's. Fields starting with _ are notes, dropped on save.

premise.zh: 楚地南境，云梦泽千里芦苇。泽中有兽，见人则鸣；泽底有一口沉钟，敲一声，水退一里。
premise.en: In the south of Chu the Yunmeng Marsh runs a thousand li of reeds. A beast in the reeds cries when it sees people; a sunken bell lies on the marsh floor, and every stroke drives the water back a li.

style.en: Shanhaijing · a hunt through the marsh

line.zh: 芦苇高过人头，水声在四面。
line.en: Reeds stand taller than a man; water sounds on every side.
A sandbar; the herons do not startle.

name.en: The shrine of the Xiang lord

line.en: Its door faces the water; the incense ash is damp.

line.zh: 潭水黑而静，底下有东西在等。
line.en: The pool is black and still; something waits below.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas — Southern Mountains

quote.zh: 杻阳之山有兽焉，其状如马而白首，其文如虎而赤尾，其音如谣，其名曰鹿蜀，佩之宜子孙。
quote.en: On Mount Niuyang is a beast like a horse with a white head, striped like a tiger, with a red tail; its cry is like a song. It is called Lushu; wear its hide and your line prospers.

look.zh: 白首赤尾，身有虎纹，鸣如歌谣。
look.en: White-headed, red-tailed, tiger-striped; it sings when it cries.

setup.zh: 船到芦苇渡，船家不肯再往里走。他说泽里有歌声，听见的人会跟着走。
setup.en: The boat stops at the reed ford; the boatman will go no further. There is singing in the marsh, he says, and those who hear it follow.

text.zh: 我也听见了。不是人唱的。
text.en: I hear it too. It is not a person singing.

label.en: Stand at the ford and listen

exits.means: listens, waits, asks the boatman about the song

text.zh: 歌声从西边来，一声近，一声远。
text.en: The song comes from the west, one note near, one far.

exits.means: goes into the marsh, follows the song, leaves the boat

text.zh: 水没到膝。芦苇在身后合拢，渡口不见了。
text.en: The water reaches your knees. The reeds close behind you; the ford is gone.

_rules: id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not a shipped world's; base is a shipped world (jiuding).
title, premise, style: {zh, en}, both. sources: the heritage the world draws on — 山海经, 楚辞, 三国志, 周易…; never a novel.

province: an id of its own and a {zh, en} name. places: 4 to 8, ids of their own, a tier the ladder has (0 to start), roads both ways, a {zh, en} line each; start names one of them; has.creature names a creature of the cast.

cast: creature ids from the bestiary (Look's creatures). creatures: up to 4 new ones — id, {zh, en} name, quote, look, and a root (metal, wood, water, fire, earth); no art: it is drawn on first appearance.
words: only ids the base has (progress, wealth, stamina, tier, cast, contest…), each {zh, en} — rename what the story needs and nothing else.

scene: the opening, in the made-scene shape (id starts with made-, chapter is made, 1 to 4 exits with means, buttons at most 3, grants from the branch table only — progress and wealth, each exit once). It is entered the moment the world begins.
The world's heritage only; never a living author's names; nothing of 九鼎's spine.
